meta.prototype: design/concession.figcraft (FigCraft, variables collection "Concession", modes Matinee and Late show)
meta.reference: Image-first cards, large radii, glass chips and pill buttons, after the Ronas IT travel-app shot the team pointed to

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm stone in Matinee, the dark of a cinema in Late show. Also the colour of the notches cut into ticket cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, white pill buttons, the selected segment.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tracks and wells: segmented-control track, empty rating seats, quiet rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on every surface (15:1 or better), and the fill of dark pill buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, counts, inactive nav, placeholders. 4.6:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only separate, and empty rating seats. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and the ticket perforation. 3:1 or better on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: velvet
tokens.usage: The one accent: the main action on a screen, page headlines, active states, Completed. 6.8:1 or better as text.

tokens.name: velvet-deep
tokens.usage: Poster placeholders that need a darker fill; the shadow tint under velvet buttons.

tokens.name: on-velvet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on velvet and dropped fills.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on dark ink pills.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Popcorn butter: filled rating seats, the unread badge, Plan to watch. A fill, never text on the ground.

tokens.name: on-butter
tokens.usage: Text on butter fills.

tokens.name: box-office
tokens.usage: Watching, success confirmations, avatars without a photo.

tokens.name: on-box-office
tokens.usage: Text and icons on box-office fills.

tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only, always with a word saying what went wrong.

tokens.name: cherry-wash
tokens.usage: Alert background behind ink text.

tokens.name: stub
tokens.usage: Behind a poster while it loads, and behind the placeholder initial.

tokens.name: dropped
tokens.usage: Dropped status fill, with on-velvet text.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Chips and round buttons floating on a poster, behind a backdrop blur. Always with on-glass text.

tokens.name: on-glass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on glass.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, offset 2px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The sign-in hero only. Italic, velvet.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles: a list's name, a title's name on its page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section headings and card titles on poster cards.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Numbers people scan for: scores, counts.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien.
styles.usage: Overviews, reviews, notes. Under 70 characters a line.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Meta lines and helper text, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between rating seats.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inset of the poster inside a card; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding; nav rhythm.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card body padding; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap in card grids; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above page titles; empty states.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Tags.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Inputs, alerts, rows.

tokens.name: radius-poster
tokens.usage: Posters inset in a card, and posters on their own.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels: ticket cards, list cards, the status panel. Inner radius = this minus the inset.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything pressable, and chips.

shadow.note: Soft and diffuse, as if lit from above a counter. One elevation for cards, one for floating things.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: White pill buttons, the selected segment, the sticky nav.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Velvet buttons: a glow in the accent's own colour.
